reason: A DeepSeek Harness vision plugin that converts images into structured JSON evidence using configurable external vision engines, with per-call provider selection.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像读取能力，将图片转换为包含 OCR、布局和语义信息的结构化 JSON，并支持按调用选择视觉引擎。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness vision plugin that converts images into structured JSON containing OCR, layout, and semantic information, with per-call vision engine selection.

capabilities: Extracts OCR, layout, and semantic information into structured JSON
Connects to configured external vision providers
Supports per-call provider selection and configured failover
Stores and uses provider configuration and API credentials
